integrity: The infinite cutoff follows from an exhaustive length-8 factor set and a prefix/suffix reversal argument. The exhaustive set is certified by the published identity rho(n)=2n+1. A standalone verifier regenerates the morphic prefix, checks the exact factor counts, reflection classes, the unique length-7 reversible factor, and the absence of reversed length-8 pairs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the fixed point of 0->01, 1->21, 2->0 and uses the published exact factor-complexity theorem to certify the exhaustive factor lists through length 8. It does not classify reversal cutoffs for other low-complexity morphic words.
title: Sharp reversal cutoff and reflection complexity of the Currie–Ochem–Rampersad–Shallit ternary word
